page.title: Sunset Cruise with Champagne & Tapas in Marbella 2038

data.meta_description: Book a sunset cruise with champagne & tapas in Marbella 2038. Sail from Puerto Banús, sip cava, and watch the sun dip behind La Concha. From €749.
data.summary: A sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in Marbella 2038 is the ultimate evening afloat. Depart Puerto Banús, toast with cava as the sun sets behind La Concha, and enjoy Spanish tapas on a private charter.

faq.q: What time does the sunset cruise depart?
faq.a: Departure times shift with the seasons. In summer (June–August) we usually cast off around 18:00 to catch the 21:00 sunset. Spring and autumn departures are earlier (16:00–17:00). We confirm the exact time when you book.

faq.q: Which boats can I book for a sunset cruise?
faq.a: Any boat in our fleet can be chartered for sunset. For a romantic evening, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a jet ski. See all options at [Boat Rental Marbella](/).

faq.q: Is champagne included in the price?
faq.a: Yes – every charter includes cava (Spanish sparkling wine). For a premium touch, we can upgrade to French champagne on request. All bookings also include white wine, beer, soft drinks, water, and light snacks.

faq.q: What food is served on the sunset cruise?
faq.a: You get a selection of Spanish tapas: cured jamón, manchego cheese, marinated olives, piquillo peppers, and crusty bread. If you have dietary requirements, let us know 48h ahead and we’ll adjust the menu.

faq.q: How many guests can come on the sunset cruise?
faq.a: Capacity depends on the boat. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 take up to 9–11 guests. The Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, and Ferretti 94 all take 12 guests. The Dubhe and Mariah SX21 are smaller (5 guests). Check [our fleet](/experiences/) for exact numbers.

faq.q: What route does the sunset cruise take?
faq.a: We leave Puerto Banús and head west toward the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina. You’ll see La Concha mountain turn pink, then cruise past Cabopino or Estepona depending on conditions. The exact route depends on wind and sunset position.

faq.q: Can I book a sunset cruise for a special occasion?
faq.a: Absolutely. We regularly host proposals, birthdays, anniversaries, and small wedding parties. Add a private photographer, flowers, or a custom cake – just tell us when you book via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What’s the cancellation policy for sunset cruises?
faq.a: Weather cancellations are free – we reschedule or refund. For personal cancellations, we require 72 hours’ notice for a full refund. Within 72 hours, a 50% cancellation fee applies. No refunds for no-shows.

data.body_html:
There’s no better way to end a day on the Costa del Sol than a sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in Marbella 2038. As the sun slips behind the Sierra Blanca mountains, you’ll be sipping cava on the Mediterranean, watching the sky turn gold, pink, and violet. This is the Marbella evening experience that turns a holiday into a memory.

Why a Sunset Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline faces west, which means you get a direct view of the sunset over the water. From Puerto Banús, you’ll cruise past the Golden Mile, Marbella Marina, and the pine-clad hills of Cabopino. The light at that hour is soft, the sea is calm, and the temperature drops to a perfect 24–26 °C in summer. A private charter means no crowds, no rush – just you, your guests, and the horizon.

What’s Included in the Sunset Cruise

Every sunset charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and a full drinks package: cava (or champagne on request), white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. You also get a tapas selection – jamón ibérico, manchego, olives, piquillos, and fresh bread. All prices include Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

Our Boats for the Sunset Cruise

We offer boats for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Sample Sunset Itinerary

A typical 2-hour sunset cruise (18:00–20:00):

  • 18:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome cava and tapas.
  • 18:15 – Depart the marina, head west along the coast.
  • 18:30 – Pass the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina. Second glass of cava.
  • 19:00 – Anchor near Cala del Faro or off Cabopino for a swim (if warm enough).
  • 19:30 – Sunset toast as the sun dips behind La Concha.
  • 20:00 – Return to Puerto Banús.

Longer charters (4h or 8h) can go as far as Estepona or Sotogrande.

How to Book Your Sunset Cruise

Booking is simple. Choose your boat, pick a date, and contact us via WhatsApp. We’ll confirm availability, departure time, and any special requests (dietary needs, flowers, photographer). Payment is by bank transfer or card. We recommend booking at least 48 hours ahead, especially in July and August.
